description: Source code for managing WPA Supplicant in a Wi-Fi plugin, including initialization, start, stop, reload, cleanup, and status functions, with callback handlers for WPA supplicant events.

methods.name: s_writeWpaSupArgsToBuf
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for wpa_supplicant based on endpoint configuration.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_init
methods.description: Initializes the WPA supplicant management for a given endpoint, setting up event handlers and interfaces.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the WPA supplicant for an endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_startDaemon
methods.description: Starts the wpa_supplicant daemon for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_stopDaemon
methods.description: Stops the wpa_supplicant daemon for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_reloadDaemon
methods.description: Reloads the wpa_supplicant configuration for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_writeConfig
methods.description: Writes the WPA supplicant configuration file for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the wpa_supplicant process is running for the endpoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_wpaSupp_isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the wpa_supplicant process is alive for the endpoint.
